video.title: Now is the Best Time to Make Money with Content (AI Tutorial)

summary: Chris Koerner argues now is a great time to earn from content inspired by other creators' content in any niche. He walks through building an n8n workflow on a Hostinger VPS (about $5/month) that reads YouTube channel RSS feeds on a schedule, appends the videos to a Google Sheet and emails a digest. Setup covers the Google Cloud Console APIs and OAuth consent, an RSS Read node, Google Sheets and Gmail nodes, and an Aggregate node to fix email spam. He suggests the tool could be resold, for example as a $30/month competitor-monitoring email to YouTubers, or sold as n8n templates. The video is promotional for Hostinger.

tactics.name: Build a YouTube competitor-tracking digest in n8n
steps: Buy a Hostinger VPS with n8n preinstalled
In Google Cloud Console create a project, enable the Gmail and Google Sheets APIs, configure the OAuth consent screen with external audience and test users
Add Gmail read/send/modify and Sheets read/write scopes
In n8n add a Schedule trigger, then an RSS Read node per channel
Get each channel's RSS URL from the page source by searching for RSS, which avoids third-party sites that harvest your email
Append publish date, channel name and title to a Google Sheet
Add an Aggregate node (titles, links) before the Gmail node so you get one digest email, not one per video
Limit to the latest 10 items per channel and schedule daily

quote.text: I'm going to add a node right here between RSS and Gmail. Hit the plus. It's going to be called aggregate.
quote.speaker: Chris Koerner

tactics.name: Use top creators' posts as content inspiration
steps: Pick a niche and identify top creators
Watch what they post that performs well
Make your own version with your spin and personality

evidence_quality.rationale: Technical tutorial that works as shown, but income claims are generic and unsubstantiated, and the resale ideas are hypothetical with no customer evidence.
evidence_quality.promotional_conflict: Sponsored by Hostinger; Koerner promotes an affiliate link and the coupon code 'kerneroffice'.
